## Outcome and authority

Link the change intent, spec, plan and relevant ADR. State whether application work is authorized.

## Scope and source changes

Identify requirement IDs and source versions. Record deviations and open owner decisions.

## Verification

List exact checks and results, including unavailable/skipped checks. Documentation-only passes do not establish runtime behavior.

## Review

Separate correctness, security/privacy and contract-compliance passes. Identify self-review versus independent review. Record material findings with owner and due condition.

## Release and recovery

State data/external effects, release gate and rollback. For documentation-only changes: no deployment, no runtime evidence.
